$comment: Opt-in agent claims. This is the ONLY source the dashboard treats as authoritative for
'who is working on this'. Nothing else in the repository records an assignee.
An agent starting sustained work on an item may add a claim here; the dashboard shows it as
an Assignee chip. Items with no claim show 'Unclaimed', which is the honest default.
expiresAt defaults to claimedAt + 24h when omitted. Expired claims render struck through,
because a stale claim is worse than no claim.
